environment.description: ECS Fargate service (platform 1.4.0) with task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/app-task-role. Credentials sourced from AWS Secrets Manager ARN with rotation Lambda (template SecretsManagerRDSPostgreSQLRotationSingleUser) configured at AutomaticallyAfterDays=0 with custom RotationSchedule using rate(60 seconds) expression. The task definition references secrets via valueFrom with the Secrets Manager ARN+version-stage AWSCURRENT. ECS agent resolves secret values at container injection time, but the application calls get_db_credentials() which reads os.environ at request time - the env vars are populated once at task start. However, the rotation Lambda also invokes ECS UpdateService with forceNewDeployment=true as a post-rotation hook via EventBridge rule on SecretsManager rotation event, causing rolling replacement of tasks every ~60s cycle. The ALB target group uses deregistration_delay=5s. Net effect: any session fixation attack captures credentials that become invalid within ≤65 seconds as the secret rotates and the task is replaced (destroying in-memory active_sessions dict), and the captured DB_AUTH_TOKEN from the old task's environment is revoked by the rotation Lambda's finishSecret step which calls RDS API to disconnect sessions using the previous credential version.

secrets_manager.rotation_hook: EventBridge rule triggers ECS UpdateService forceNewDeployment on aws.secretsmanager RotationSucceeded event

rds_config.token_validity: derived from rotated secret, previous version revoked on finishSecret
